name: Medication Lifecycle Kernel

hazardCase.hazardousCondition: A prescription is written or activated while a safety barrier (interaction, duplication, contraindication, dose ceiling, renal adjustment, pediatric dose) could not be evaluated, and that absence is presented or persisted as 'safe'.
foreseeableSequence: drug outside catalog or missing weight/eGFR
hazardCase.potentialHarm: Adverse drug event from an unverified interaction, contraindication or dose.

hazardCase.hazardousCondition: A drug with a documented severe allergy, major interaction, therapeutic duplication, diagnosis contraindication or renal contraindication is prescribed, resumed or modified without an accountable, justified override.
foreseeableSequence: block bypassed by UI path or silently accepted
hazardCase.potentialHarm: Anaphylaxis, bleeding, toxicity or organ injury without traceable clinical decision.

hazardCase.hazardousCondition: A daily dose above the absolute ceiling or above the pediatric mg/kg maximum is accepted.
foreseeableSequence: dose or frequency mistyped or misjudged
no computation of mg/day or mg/kg/day
hazardCase.potentialHarm: Overdose (hepatotoxicity, nephrotoxicity, death), especially in children.

hazardCase.hazardousCondition: A prescription or clinical signature is executed by an actor without physician authority or without a registered legal professional identity (cédula profesional).
foreseeableSequence: role string trusted from client, or AI/system actor
no professional identity bound to the act
hazardCase.potentialHarm: Unlawful prescription; no accountable prescriber; patient harm without recourse.

controls.name: Single six-state prescription safety evaluator; NOT_EVALUATED never CLEAR; explicit acknowledgement with justification (428 SAFETY_ACK_REQUIRED)
Server-side barrier enforcement on PRESCRIBE/RESUME/MODIFY with named, justified, audited override (decideOverride)
Hard, non-overridable daily dose ceiling and pediatric mg/kg maximum (proposal and prescription)
PRESCRIBE and signature require PHYSICIAN role and registered professional credentials (cédula); identity snapshot persisted in the event

invariants.statement: A prescription barrier that could not be evaluated is never presented or persisted as PASSED, and a verdict with NOT_EVALUATED barriers is never CLEAR; prescribing then requires explicit acknowledgement with justification.

A BLOCKED overridable barrier is lifted only by naming that barrier with a clinical justification recorded with the prescriber; naming a non-blocking barrier is rejected; hard barriers are never lifted.
A computed daily dose above the absolute ceiling, or above the pediatric mg/kg/day maximum, is BLOCKED and cannot be overridden.
PRESCRIBE and clinical signature require PHYSICIAN authority and registered professional credentials; the legal identity is persisted with the act.
AI/system cannot promote recommendation to DECIDED/SIGNED clinical authority.

safetyArgument: Authority establishes intended behavior and boundaries.
Controls prevent, detect, correct, or recover from those conditions.
Invariants define conditions that must remain true.
Tests provide executable oracles; execution evidence is separately required.
Capability remains blocked when any required safety-case element is absent.
